newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM eyes fiscal reform bills in Sept -- MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM eyes fiscal reform bills in Sept -- MOF.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto has said he would like to submit bills to restructure state finances to an extraordinary session of parliament in September, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said on Tuesday.
The government is currently discussing how to go about achieving the goal of reducing the fiscal deficit to three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) by fiscal 2005.

Mitsuzuka told the budget committee of the Lower House of parliament he would like to tackle the task of preparing the bills and submit them at the end of the current parliament session, which closes in June.
Since there would be insufficient time to debate the bills submitted at the end of the parliament session, they would be discussed again in the next session.
